Name: Stack To Nearby Casks
Author: stebaker92
Description:
[size=5][b]Stack To Nearby Casks - One Click to Fill Nearby Casks![/b][/size]

Tired of interacting with every single cask one by one just to drop in a bottle of wine? Stack To Nearby Casks adds one button to your inventory that fills every empty cask around you in a single click.

If you've built out a cellar (or a farm full of casks), you know exactly how much clicking this mod will save.

[heading]✨ How Stack To Nearby Casks Works[/heading]
[b]Click one button, every empty cask nearby will be filled instantly.[/b]
[list]
[*]Open your inventory[/*]
[*]Click the stack button in the corner[/*]
[*]Every empty cask within range gets filled with your configured items[/*]
[*]Holding a single item? Click the button to drop just that item into the nearest empty cask instead[/*]
[/list][b]That's it.[/b] No more walking rows of casks one at a time and missing the odd cask. 



[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley:[/b] 1.6 Compatible[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI:[/b] 4.3.2+[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer?[/b] Untested in multiplayer[/*]
[*][b]Other Mods:[/b] No known conflicts.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Frequently Asked Questions[/heading]
[b][i]Q: Which items get stacked by default?[/i][/b]
A: Wine and cheese. You can edit `config.json` to add or remove any items you like.

[b][i]Q: How far away can casks be for the button to reach them?[/i][/b]
A: Configurable via the `radius` setting in `config.json` (default: 10 tiles).

[b][i]Q: What happens to Iridium-quality items?[/i][/b]
A: They're skipped automatically, so your best-quality goods never get swept into a cask by accident.

[b][i]Q: Can I place just one specific item instead of stacking everything?[/i][/b]
A: Yes — hold that item on your cursor and click the button to place only that item into the nearest empty cask.

[b][i]Q: Does it fill casks that already have something in them?[/i][/b]
A: No, only empty casks are targeted, so nothing already aging gets disturbed.
